F1.shape: a=mean(month1,month2), b=mean(month4,month5,month6); rising b>1.1*a; falling b<0.9*a; stable otherwise; zeros use exact y==0
F1.SVD: 12-dimensional centered target, unweighted SVD; training wells only; full_matrices=False; validation truth projected for oracle diagnostic only
F1.score: official per-well OOF recomputation; not unweighted mean of folds
F1.interpretation: target-informed upper-reference diagnostic, not deployable OOF prediction or evidence that basis coefficients are predictable

Dalpha.required_input: existing exact fixed-OOF predictions with row/feature/environment/split source identity; aggregate scores or all-data model are insufficient
Dalpha.cross_estimation: outer validation fold uses residuals from other four folds at same horizon only; samples y_star=p*exp(e_j); candidates y_star plus zero; minimize sample mean official monthly loss
Dalpha.caveat: other-fold OOF models may have trained on current validation wells; prescribed cross-estimated diagnostic is not an independently nested deployment validation
Dalpha.if_input_absent: UNKNOWN P1; do not substitute a model replay or invented row predictions

Dbeta.incomplete: 7 excluded training wells; count finite nonnegative labels at last event end+1/+2
Dbeta.historical: only 81 complete training wells; eligible records collapsed into contiguous segments; preceding segment ends; exact calendar-consecutive 12 months, finite nonnegative targets, no eligible event in that window
Dbeta.increase: sum of additional valid labels from incomplete latest events and qualified historical events, divided by 81, reported separately and combined

Dgamma.cohort: all 88 training wells, each only through own M-1
Dgamma.differences: finite nonnegative consecutive natural-calendar months only; no gap bridging; log(q+delta) difference
Dgamma.common: equal-well arithmetic mean per calendar month if >=5 valid differences
Dgamma.share: population variance of eligible common monthly means / population variance of all valid training well-month log differences
Dgamma.lag1: Pearson correlation of eligible common means in adjacent calendar months only; no gap bridging
